surface: AVG32 / SCN2k LZSS 'clip the final back-reference against the declared uncompressed size' branch, reached only when a compressed stream ends with a back-reference that overshoots the target buffer.
why_real_only: The synthetic G00 (type-1/type-2) and Seen.txt corpora are compressed LITERAL-ONLY (compress_avg32_literal / encode_all_literals), so decode is input-bounded and never reaches the out_size clip. Authoring a tail-overshoot back-reference stream is possible but adds no decode-LOGIC coverage beyond what is already covered below.
logic_still_covered_by: The back-reference COPY logic (distance/run-length/window) is exercised by the utsushi-reallive decompressor synthetic unit tests (synthetic_pure_back_references_round_trip and siblings) and the type-0 G00 fixture's trailing back-reference token; only the exact out_size CLIP arithmetic is real-only.
